$comment: Agent skills vendored into .claude/skills/. Every skill lives here as a real directory (no symlinks, no .agents/ mirror) and the commit it came from is recorded below. The original copy came by hand from leolicona/miabot@ae37d82 on 2026-09-08; guide-me took this set from leolicona/devolada@d033435 on 2026-10-03, dropping shadcn (guide-me's UI is MUI v9), durable-objects and agents-sdk (Workers primitives guide-me does not use). To update a skill, fetch it again from its upstream at a newer commit and record the commit here: either copy the directory by hand, or run the upstream's installer in a scratch dir (e.g. `npx skills add <repo>`), copy only the skills listed here out of it, and delete what the installer left behind (.agents/, skills-lock.json, symlinks in .claude/skills/). The selection is deliberate: an installer that adds a whole catalog brings skills this project does not use, and every skill description costs context in every session.

cloudflare.note: Upstream publishes 14 skills; only these two are vendored. wrangler and workers-best-practices back both of guide-me's Workers (api-turistear, app-turistear) and their D1 bindings. Deliberately left out: durable-objects and agents-sdk (guide-me uses neither primitive), cloudflare (product chooser), cloudflare-one, cloudflare-one-migrations, cloudflare-email-service, nextjs-on-cloudflare, sandbox-stable, sandbox-next, sandbox-migrate-to-next, turnstile-spin, web-perf.

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.overlay: SKILL.md is a devolada overlay, not upstream's: it reads the vendored guidelines.md instead of fetching at runtime, defers to constitution Principle VI and the CI gates, and exempts es-MX copy from the English Content & Copy rules. Re-vendoring replaces guidelines.md only — never overwrite SKILL.md with upstream's.

vercel.note: guide-me's frontend (app-turistear) is a Vite SPA: the React rules apply, the server/Next.js rules (server-*, hydration) do not. web-design-guidelines was ported from leolicona/miabot on 2026-09-09 at the same upstream commit; guidelines.md is the vendored asset and SKILL.md carries the overlay described on that skill (rewritten for guide-me's design system and gates).

antfu.note: Maintained by a Vite/Vitest core team member; generated from official docs

secondsky.note: Community collection; taken because Drizzle on D1 has no official skill

leolicona.note: Own catalog. The package name is @leolicona/agent-skills but it is NOT published to npm, so `npx @leolicona/agent-skills` returns 404: run the CLI from a clone instead (`node bin/cli.mjs add project-brief --target claude --dir <project>`). Installed with --target claude, which writes only .claude/skills/<skill>/ and leaves no .agents/ mirror, symlinks or lockfile of its own. Of the two skills in the catalog only project-brief is vendored; tech-feasibility is deliberately left out. project-brief names no stack convention, so no task is required to load it: it is the discovery step that produces the brief feeding /speckit-constitution and /speckit-specify.
